array_order_inventory.ambiguity_resolution: Task.claim_rosters uniqueItems does not name a comparison key. Explicit V1 profile chooses complete canonical roster-object C(row), including expected seats; not Claim-label sorting. Body.rules uniqueItems is overridden by its addressable record-array C(id) rule. Claim.conflict_claims uses C(complete ClaimLabel). These restrictive explicit choices are recorded in design-addendum.json; generic schema alone does not imply them.
array_order_inventory.comparator: C(v)=complete W02 canonical UTF8 JSON bytes, compared lexicographically as bytes, without normalization. Record arrays use C(record.id); Claims use tuple(C(id),C(revision)). Global output addressable records use C(addressable pin ID). This explicitly preserves schema-admitted final-LF Id behavior; C(string) includes JSON quoting/escapes, not Python raw Unicode string order.
preserved_order_exceptions: Body.history[*].related_record_ids (admitted history preservation exception despite uniqueItems)
Guard.nodes in Claim/selected DeclarationSource: preserve node order and exact operand fields/repetition
Existing output dependency path order is semantic and remains ordered
Opaque Blob/source content arrays are never assigned metadata set semantics

caps.inherited: All frozen input/source/claim/impact/record/depth/work/package/source physical count and byte/output caps remain. Inline registry and Seat copies count each time toward96 record objects; no alias or duplicate-byte charging is hidden.
caps.work: Only loops over shape-bounded lists: <=96 addressable records, <=16 Claim labels, <=8 Seats, <=32 Manifests with <=64 dependencies/16 selectors/16 sources/4 rules each. No recursion or unbounded cache. A sort may cache its finite key vector: aggregate canonical input-subtree sort-key bytes<=Body65536; record IDs/derived Claim IDs similarly bounded by contained record bytes. At most one sort key vector at a time; canonical complete-record scratch separately<=65536, output<=32768, all existing process-memory caps remain. This is not a one-key-at-a-time claim, and no arbitrary caller-selected tree is sorted. Bound before accumulating; overflow CONTEXT_SORT_KEY_BOUND at CONTEXT_ARRAY_ORDER, no partial result.

entrypoint: check_context_bindings(body_raw:object,originals:object,held_update_pins:object)->owned bounded dict. Invoke entire frozen impact/claim/source/input gate via private owned validated-impact bundle, including every inherited output bound and refusal; no caller parsed object/trusted bool/schema/provider/filesystem/model and no repeated source/schema IO.
forbidden_substitution_controls: Task.task_text full Pin of exact existing UpdateNotice/Provenance/Reading => CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_TYPE; raw response Blob with fresh full pin => CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_KIND.

Manifest.prompt/settings full Pin of exact existing postassessment nonBlob record => CONTEXT_MANIFEST_PROMPT_TYPE / CONTEXT_MANIFEST_SETTINGS_TYPE, even if bytes/pin match perfectly; RAW_RESPONSE Blob with fresh pin => corresponding KIND error.

Manifest.task postassessment Pin => CONTEXT_MANIFEST_TASK; ClaimKey naming absent/nonClaim id/revision => CONTEXT_MANIFEST_CLAIM; postassessment selector/dependency/rule/policy Pins => respective exact SET/POLICY error, no generic resolver salvage.
Manifest added response/result/provenance/run fields or Registry digest fields => unchanged inherited closed-schema refusal; no unknown extension lane.

Seat evidence complete SourceKey identifies only actual supplied original. Opaque original may contain bytes resembling or equal to a later record; typed binding can MATCH while temporal origin/independence stays UNKNOWN. No arbitrary semantic/parser/record-type inference from original contents.
fullwire_ambiguities: Explicit owner V1 profile resolves raw Claim namespace, derived IDs, exact Task source set, Manifest sets and canonical Task roster order. Opaque temporal origin remains UNKNOWN. History.related_record_ids global role closure and all dynamic/external references remain within full_reference_closure NOT_EVALUATED; ordering those arrays does not validate their targets.

identity_namespace.addressable: Exactly body Registry, its body Seats, body Policy, all elements of every Body record array (including Rules/Tasks/Claims), excluding deliberate inline Manifest.registry_snapshot/Seat copies as new identities. A Claim addressable ID is exact claim_id+":"+revision; all other addressable IDs are record.id. Pin hashes/lengths bind complete canonical record, with only Pin.id overridden to derived Claim ID; no record field omitted.
identity_namespace.raw_claim_labels: Distinct raw Claim.id labels reserve names against nonClaim record IDs, while multiple exact distinct revisions may share raw Claim.id. Raw labels are not generic Pin addresses. Derived Claim pin IDs are separately required to fit pinned Id ASCII<=32/pattern-search semantics and be globally unique. Colon concatenation collisions refuse; no escaping/normalization. Raw Claim label matching another Claim-derived pin ID is not a nonClaim collision and does not create a generic alias.
identity_namespace.unknown: Body record identity is recomputed local canonical integrity, not separately held external record-pin matching. External full record_pins, record provenance/custody and runtime/bootstrap remain later gates.

integration_obligation: Inherited-impact-first priority is this internal component boundary only. A future fullReplay orchestrator must enforce original frozen wire PREPARSE/BOUNDS/ADMISSION/IDENTITY/REFERENCES/GRAPHS/RECOMPUTATION/IMPORT/OUTPUT order and must not blindly chain public components while claiming fullwire refusal-order equivalence. Fullwire external pins/identity and remaining references stay binding.
ordering: All context iteration/output ordering uses declared canonical UTF8 comparison C, with Claim label pair comparator as specified; original guard/history/path semantic order is preserved. Gate-order choices are component-local.
profile_choices: Owner provisional V1 constraints resolve underspecification; they are explicit restrictive profile choices, not deductions that the generic JSON shape implies them. Separate addendum retains alternatives/rationale. No schema, resource cap or existing full-replay gate is changed.

refusal_shape.error: exact named code; exactly three fields; no partial success
refusal_shape.stage: exact first stage or unchanged inherited stage

required_evidence: Exact owner-reviewed contract/addendum/manual complete oracle + independent actual GPT-6.1 review, then separate finite budget/admission before implementation. Existing fullwire/holdout/native/recovery/product acceptance remains binding.
scope: Exact global addressable record identity, sole Task/static Registry/RuleSpec/Policy links and every supplied preassessment InputManifest. This is internal informational typed reference integrity, no full ReplayResult/acceptedReplay, observation eligibility, source truth, temporal provenance, authentication, authority or model call.

stage_order.rule: Entire frozen public impact-equivalent gate, including complete claim/source/input pipeline and all output caps, first. Propagate exact status/error/stage unchanged. Private bundle contains only owned Body, verified originals, pinned schema and completed impact data; no public dict bypass.

First check duplicate nonClaim record.id globally (CONTEXT_ID_DUPLICATE), deterministic fixed type order Registry, Seat, Policy, then Body arrays by field name and records by id (Claims excepted). Next every distinct raw Claim.id label against nonClaim IDs (CONTEXT_CLAIM_LABEL_COLLISION). Then Claims by(id,revision): exact concatenated derived ID must satisfy existing Id predicate (CONTEXT_CLAIM_PIN_ID_SHAPE), then all derived IDs unique and disjoint nonClaim addressable IDs (CONTEXT_ID_DUPLICATE). No inline Registry-copy identities are indexed. Compute exact full canonical record pins only after namespace checks.

After global namespace checks, enforce exhaustive array_order_inventory. Traverse inventory in exactly listed group order record_arrays, canonical_ID_scalar_arrays, canonical_complete_object_arrays; wildcard parents in their record-array order and fields in listed inventory order. Array must equal its own sorted copy using the declared comparator, else CONTEXT_ARRAY_ORDER. No sorting/repair of candidate record bytes. Record-array Rules and Registry Seats take record-ID order despite uniqueItems. Do not sort preserved-order exceptions. Later semantic reference errors do not precede this component order gate.

Every body Seat in C(id) order: MANUAL_DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE requires declared_model_id=null and identity_assurance=MANUAL_FIXTURE_ONLY; RECORDED_EXTERNAL_ASSESSOR requires identity_assurance=UNVERIFIED, else CONTEXT_SEAT_ORIGIN. Nonnull identity_evidence.source must be an identical complete SourceKey among verified supplied originals, else CONTEXT_SEAT_EVIDENCE_SOURCE. It resolves only an original SourceKey, never a generic record Pin/Q_RECORDS/run/result record. Assertion text remains declared data. Supplied original bytes are opaque; temporal origin and independence remain UNKNOWN and authors UNVERIFIED, including byte content that resembles later records.

Sole Task.registry_id=body.registry.id (CONTEXT_TASK_REGISTRY), policy_id=body.policy.id (CONTEXT_TASK_POLICY), rule_ids exact Body RuleSpec ID set (CONTEXT_TASK_RULE_SET). Body input already admits exact four V1 rule kinds/versions and fixed Policy. Every Claim.task_view_id equals sole Task.id (CONTEXT_TASK_CLAIM_OWNER). Task roster ClaimLabels unique (CONTEXT_TASK_ROSTER_DUPLICATE), exact set of all supplied Claims (CONTEXT_TASK_ROSTER_SET), then rows in their already verified C(complete roster object) order, each row first exact complete canonical ClaimKey (CONTEXT_TASK_ROSTER_PIN), then that same row expected_seat_ids subset body Registry Seat IDs (CONTEXT_TASK_ROSTER_SEAT), before advancing to next row. No all-pin-first second pass. Empty expected roster remains explicit and allowed. selected_sources exact unique complete verified SourceKey set of Body.sources, collapsing key aliases for set identity only, else CONTEXT_TASK_SOURCE_SET. context_dependency_ids subset all actual Dependency IDs, else CONTEXT_TASK_CONTEXT_DEPENDENCY. This exact source-set policy covers every supplied Body.sources key and source validated by inherited/static checks. Deferred dynamic SourceKey targets (including Reading/RunEvidence fields) remain NOT_EVALUATED and may still fail later; no hidden all-Body dynamic closure claim.

For each Claim by declared Claim pair comparator, every conflict_claims ClaimLabel in its verified C(complete ClaimLabel) array order must name exact actually supplied id/revision, else CONTEXT_CLAIM_CONFLICT_MISSING. No semantic contradiction inference, symmetry requirement, selection of a winner or invented self-reference prohibition; self labels remain accepted exact data. This closes labels only, separate from informational update-effect conflicts.

Optional Task.task_text: resolve ID in global index (CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_MISSING), require Blob record type (CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_TYPE), exact full canonical record pin (CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_PIN), kind TASK_TEXT (CONTEXT_TASK_TEXT_KIND), in that order. No optional nonnull reference may disappear.

Every supplied Manifest in C(id) order, independently; no new coverage requirement if there are no manifests/readings. Check exact sole Task full Pin (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_TASK); exact supplied ClaimKey by label/pin and Claim belongs Task (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_CLAIM); source_versions exact Task.selected_sources set (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_SOURCE_SET); selector pins exact full canonical pins for target Claim.selector_ids (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_SELECTOR_SET); dependency pins exact full canonical pins for union(target Claim.dependency_ids,Task.context_dependency_ids) (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_DEPENDENCY_SET). Missing/extra/stale/wrongtype pinned records refuse set equality, no candidate repair. registry_snapshot complete canonical structural equality to body.registry (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_REGISTRY); rule_specs exact four full canonical Body RuleSpec pins (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_RULE_SET); policy exact complete body Policy pin (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_POLICY). Then prompt followed by settings: resolve ID (CONTEXT_MANIFEST_PROMPT_MISSING / SETTINGS_MISSING), require Blob type (..._TYPE), full canonical Blob record Pin equality (..._PIN), then Blob kind PROMPT / SETTINGS (..._KIND). Blob payload integrity/encoding was already checked; these are full record pins. All constraints apply even unused manifests.

Typed allowed digest graph reached from each Manifest is only Task, Claim, Selector, Dependency, RuleSpec, Policy, inline static Registry/Seats, SourceKey original leaves, TASK_TEXT/PROMPT/SETTINGS Blob leaves, and exact Claim target keys. The preceding exact sets and typed pin checks close every permitted edge. ID-only links are not content digest edges. No Reading, RAW_RESPONSE, RunEvidence, Provenance, Challenge, withdrawal, UpdateNotice, HistoryEntry, receipt, result, final package/request or Manifest-self pin may be substituted in any such Pin field. Resolved record type/kind exclusion is mechanical; opaque leaf contents are not parsed as semantic references and cannot prove preassessment temporal independence. Full body-wide digest graph and remaining dynamic references are NOT_EVALUATED.

Construct complete closed result only after all checks. Canonical complete output plus reserved single LF<=32768, else CONTEXT_OUTPUT_BYTE_BOUND. No success prefix/trimming. Complete result exposes index/status pins without full originals/Body copies or nested acceptedReplayResult. Depth<=12 remains inherited and required.

success_shape.records: C(addressableID) sorted closed entries {id,record_type,sha256,bytes}, exactly every addressable record, canonical complete record hash/length with derived Claim Pin IDs. record_type is one of Registry,Seat,Policy,RuleSpec,TaskView,SourceVersion,Claim,Selector,Dependency,InputManifest,Blob,Provenance,RunEvidence,Reading,Challenge,ReadingWithdrawal,UpdateNotice,HistoryEntry. Index membership/type/hash is structural identity data only: noncontext Reading, RunEvidence, Provenance, Challenge, Withdrawal and History.related fields are not semantically/reference-qualified by appearing here.
success_shape.seat_evidence: Seat-ID sorted closed entries {seat_id,source:null|completeSourceKey,typed_binding:ABSENT|MATCH_SUPPLIED_ORIGINAL,temporal_origin:UNKNOWN,authentication:UNVERIFIED}; no absent/null substitution for declared evidence.
